exact_only_code_delta.before: [ET.tostring(x) for x in newxml[:97]]==[ET.tostring(x) for x in oldxml]
exact_only_code_delta.after: [ET.tostring(x).strip() for x in newxml[:97]]==[ET.tostring(x).strip() for x in oldxml]

mechanism: ElementTree.tostring includes whitespace-only tail after each URL element. Appending another sibling changes the previous final URL tail indentation; strip only the surrounding serialized-element whitespace. Full original sitemap bytes must independently recover exactly after deleting the3newURL lines, so existing substantive or internal XML-byte changes still fail.
